cards.title: Manual Time Range Selection for Slope Estimation
cards.claim: Users can manually specify the time range for Lambda Z or Slope estimation. Phoenix performs linear regression of ln(concentration) (or raw values for drug effect) on the user-specified points. The estimated slope must be negative for Lambda Z (which is then negated to be positive). For drug effect models, slopes can be positive or negative and are reported as-is.
conditions: User must specify the time range.
For Lambda Z, the resulting slope must be negative.
For drug effect Slope 1/2, linear or log regression can be chosen, and slope sign is not constrained to negative.
limitations: If the user-specified range contains fewer than two non-missing observations, estimation fails.
Manual selection bypasses the automatic 'Best Fit' logic but still requires valid data points for regression.
cards.downstream_use: Allows override of automatic selection when automatic methods fail or select inappropriate points due to noise or sparse sampling.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
